description: Read and display NMEA GPS data from a serial GPS device

variables.name: tx
variables.description: Board TX pin (connect to the GPS module's RX)

variables.name: rx
variables.description: Board RX pin (connect to the GPS module's TX)

variables.name: baud
variables.description: Serial baud rate for GPS communication

variables.name: print_interval
variables.description: Interval between printing GPS data (in seconds)
